decisions.reason: The enclosed manual laser marking workstation extends the firm's established laser portfolio, serves workshop and small-batch customers at low incremental cost, and was launched only recently, so dropping it within a year is unlikely even though it is only mentioned on the website.

The high-resolution thermal inkjet printer sits at the core of the firm's coding business, has its own product page, and generates recurring consumables revenue, so it fits the firm's single-source strategy.

The high-resolution piezo inkjet printer complements the thermal inkjet line for different surfaces and applications, is prominently presented, and supports the firm's traceability direction, so it will very likely be retained.
